resources.string: Shortened link: you cannot see where it goes.
The name is coded and may show other letters than it is made of.
The name mixes alphabets, which fake sites often do.
The address is a number, not a website name.
The name looks like %1$s. Check the spelling.
The part before the @ is not the website.
Risky links cannot be opened here. You can copy the link.
The link sheet then only copies and shares
